_comment: Competitor comparison data updated from DFT database and official pages on 2026-06-05. Facts are curated; unavailable fields are marked as not publicly disclosed. role_strengths are derived by engine from curriculum_focus. A cell of the four PDF dimensions (typical_profile / industry_orientation / technical_depth / career_pathways) may only be marked verified when its text restates a fact published on the row source_url; qualitative judgements stay synthesis.
disclaimer: The comparison is based on official public information and the curated programme database. It is for fit analysis only and is not a ranking. Fees, deadlines, and curriculum arrangements may change; please refer to each school's latest official page.

programs.program: NUS MSc in Digital Financial Technology

values.curriculum_focus: 52 Units: 28 Units core/essential + 12 Units electives + 12 Units FT5007 capstone. Electives across Computing Technologies, Financial Data Analytics and Intelligence, and Digital Financial Transactions and Risk Management. Career outcomes include AI software developer, data scientist, FinTech security specialist and financial quantitative analyst.
values.duration: Full-time normal duration 1.5 years; part-time normal duration 2.5 years; maximum 3 years.
values.format: On-campus coursework plus two-semester FT5007 FinTech Capstone Project; capstone can be academic research or industry-linked/internship-style project.
values.fees: S$74,120 tuition fee for AY2026/2027 August 2026 intake onwards, covering up to 52 Units; acceptance fee S$7,412 credited towards tuition; application fee S$109.
values.intake: August 2026 intake; application opens 1 Oct 2025 and closes 31 Jan 2026; outcome by end May via Graduate Admission System.
values.scholarship: NUS Master's by Coursework Enhanced Tuition Fee Rebate: 40% tuition fee rebate for eligible Singapore Citizens/PRs; IMDA SG Digital Scholarship and NUS GRTII scholarship may apply subject to eligibility.
values.gmat_gre: GRE guideline 320 + AW 3.5; GMAT guideline 650; GMAT/GRE is not mandatory and there is no fixed cutoff. TOEFL iBT 90 / IELTS 6.0 if applicable.

typical_profile.text: Suitable for applicants from CS, engineering, or quantitative backgrounds who want to enter FinTech; GRE/GMAT is not mandatory.

industry_orientation.text: Two-semester FT5007 FinTech Capstone Project; the capstone can be an academic research project or an industry-linked/internship-style project.

technical_depth.text: High technical depth: computing technologies, financial data analytics and intelligence, and digital financial transactions and risk.

career_pathways.text: Career outcomes stated by the programme: AI software developer, data scientist, FinTech security specialist, and financial quantitative analyst.

programs.program: SMU MSc in Applied Finance (FinTech track)

values.curriculum_focus: Applied finance programme focused on international and domestic financial markets; students can choose finance/fintech-related electives and internship options.
values.duration: 18 months full-time; 24 months part-time. Official page also notes possible 12-month completion option for full-time track.
values.format: On-campus coursework with internship option through SMU partner network.
values.fees: S$63,220 tuition fee inclusive of GST; application fee S$100; registration/advance tuition fees apply.
values.intake: August intake; full-time and part-time application period October to May, extended to June 2026 for current cycle.
values.scholarship: SMU scholarships/discounts may be available; check official programme page.
values.gmat_gre: Prerequisites include Bachelor's degree and GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test; TOEFL/IELTS if undergraduate medium was not English.

typical_profile.text: Suitable for applicants with finance or business backgrounds who want applied finance and FinTech exposure.

industry_orientation.text: Coursework programme with an internship option offered through the SMU partner network.

technical_depth.text: Moderate technical depth: primarily applied finance, with FinTech as a specialisation option.

career_pathways.text: Applied finance, financial markets, and FinTech-related roles.
